resources.string: %1$s isn\'t ready yet: the list below says exactly what\'s missing.
Swipe pans · tap right-clicks · hold left-clicks
Warcraft %1$s · offline, no Battle.net · Warcraft I and II by Stratagus
Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne are one Warcraft III install: its files serve both. Which of the two the game opens is chosen in its own main menu, and it remembers.

From your PC: the Warcraft III 1.30 folder (the repack\'s folder as it unzips, about 1.8 GB), or its zip as it is. Copy it to the phone\'s Downloads, then Game files → Pick folder or Pick zip. These must be in it:

From GOG: the installed Warcraft: Orcs & Humans folder (on a PC, C:\\GOG Games\\Warcraft Orcs & Humans or wherever GOG put it), or a zip of it. Copy it to the phone\'s Downloads, then Game files → Pick folder or Pick zip. The app then converts it for the phone by itself (a few minutes). This must be in it:

From GOG: the installed Warcraft II Battle.net Edition folder (on a PC, C:\\GOG Games\\Warcraft II BNE or wherever GOG put it), or a zip of it. Copy it to the phone\'s Downloads, then Game files → Pick folder or Pick zip. The app then converts it for the phone by itself (a few minutes). These must be in it:
The DATA folder with DATA.WAR and the other .WAR files (maps, units, sounds, the cutscenes\' pictures).
The four tomes in Support\\TOMES: maps, units, graphics.
Install.mpq, beside the game\'s program (about 490 MB).
The app does this itself once the files above are in, in a few minutes. Game files → Convert again redoes it.
What starts the game. Game files can point at another .exe if yours is elsewhere.
The Data folder, with the data, indices and config folders inside it: maps, units, sound and video.
.build.info, a hidden file beside Data. On Windows, turn on View → Hidden items to see it; copying the whole folder takes it along.
The Maps folder. The campaigns are in the game\'s data and don\'t need it; skirmish and custom games do.
Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne keys, asked at the first start. The repack\'s _SERIAL_KEYS.txt has them and the app\'s menu types them; your own keys work too.
Room: the game\'s files, and about as much again for the converted data. Free now: %1$s.
Room: the game\'s size, plus about 1.5 GB for the games\' Windows the first time. Free now: %1$s.

Played natively on the phone by Stratagus (War1gus, Wargus): an open-source engine that plays the game from your files, campaigns and skirmishes, the original art and sounds. The intro videos are left out, and Warcraft II\'s music (converting those needs a tool phones don\'t have).
The conversion stopped (code %1$d). Its last lines:\n%2$s
Only the first time, and after an update that changes it.
%1$s isn\'t on this phone yet: add its files in Game files.
The Windows runtime couldn\'t be installed. Check there\'s free space (about 1.5 GB) and try again.
The games\' Windows couldn\'t be made. Check there\'s free space and try again.
CD keys that came with the game: a tap types it into the game\'s key box (tap the box first).
Save first: leaving ends the game where it is. A two-finger tap opens the game\'s own menu, with Save and Quit.
A message, or a cheat code
A name, a CD key, a saved game\'s name…

Bring the Warcraft III 1.30 folder from a PC: the one with Warcraft III.exe, Data and Maps in it (the 1.30 repack\'s folder as it unzips), or the zip itself. It holds both Reign of Chaos and The Frozen Throne, their campaigns and maps.

Bring Warcraft: Orcs & Humans from GOG: the installed folder (with WAR.EXE and the DATA folder in it), or a zip of it. The app converts it for the phone after the copy; it\'s then played natively by Stratagus.

Bring Warcraft II Battle.net Edition from GOG: the installed folder (with Warcraft II BNE.exe, Install.mpq and Support\\TOMES in it), or a zip of it. The app converts it for the phone after the copy; it\'s then played natively by Stratagus.
Put the folder or zip on the phone itself first (Downloads is fine): files in a cloud folder can\'t be read fast enough. Adding again replaces what\'s there.
What the program is started with (this game\'s default: %1$s).
Keep Blizzard\'s servers out of reach

Battle.net, the patch servers and Blizzard\'s sites are blocked for every game: nothing can sign in, update or download. Campaigns, custom games against the computer and local network games don\'t need them.
Delete this game\'s files from the app? Saved games stay (they\'re in the games\' Windows); add the files again to play.
It didn\'t work: open the app to see why.
There\'s no Windows program (.exe) in what was picked: pick the game\'s folder itself, or its zip.
Not enough free space: it needs %1$s and %2$s is free.

The games are drawn at this size and scaled to the screen; on the Fold\'s nearly square inside screen they\'re 4:3 with bars at the sides, never squeezed. Fewer lines run faster. It applies the next time a game starts, for the screen the launcher is on then.
Every pixel of the screen the launcher is on (the Fold\'s inside or outside)
The Fold\'s outside screen\'s own; on the inside, a quarter of the pixels to draw
-graphicsapi OpenGL2: try it if the picture is wrong with Direct3D
A short buzz when touch and hold right-clicks
Pans the map the way you swipe, for as long as the finger stays away from where it landed. Lift to stop.
Right click: move, attack, gather, set a rally point.
Left click when you lift (after a short buzz): select a unit or building, press a button of the game\'s panel or menus.
Hold twice on the same spot
Double click: every unit of that kind on the screen.
Rest one finger, tap or hold with another
Shift-click: queue orders one after another, add units to the selection.
The game\'s menu (save, load, options, quit).
Zoom (the mouse wheel), where the game has it.
The phone\'s keyboard, for chat and cheat codes (sent with Enter).
The app\'s menu: keyboard, CD keys, leave the game.
Escape: cancel what\'s being aimed, close a window.
A mouse or keyboard connected to the phone works as on a PC.
